author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I have even studied the grammar of Esperanto to understand what it’s about, and I came to two conclusions. It is a very, very well-made language. From the linguistic viewpoint, it really follows admirable criteria of economy of language and efficiency. Secondly, all other movements for international languages have failed, but not that of Esperanto, which further unites humanity everywhere in the world, because behind Esperanto is an idea, an ideal.

text: 我甚至研究過世界語嘅文法，去理解佢嘅意思，我得出咗兩個結論，佢係一種非常非常好嘅語言。從語言學嘅角度睇，佢真係遵循咗令人佩服嘅語言經濟同效率標準。其次，所有其他國際語言嘅運動都失敗咗，但係世界語嘅運動就冇失敗過，因為世界語嘅背後更加團結咗世界各地嘅人類，因為世界語背後係一個想法，一個理想。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: After his colonoscopy, Tom learned that he had cancer. The surgeon cut out and removed the part of his sigmoid colon in which a tumour had been growing, and with staples she fashioned a new splice from the two shorter and cut-through ends. Because of his good health, he healed quickly and after only three days was discharged from the hospital.

text: 喺佢做咗結腸鏡檢查之後，湯姆先知道自己有癌症。外科醫生切開同切除咗佢個西格瑪結腸入面有個腫瘤一直生長緊嘅部分，然後佢用釘書釘喺兩個較短同切開嘅端度整咗個新嘅剪接。因為佢嘅健康狀況良好，佢好快就好返，只係三日就出院。
